## Summary
Authenticated demo session and browser mutation boundary. Authenticated user session required for all writes; CSRF/origin/rate-limit tests; backend token never returned to browser; direct unauthorized requests fail.

## Owner Role
Lead / akiibot. A single PR author owns this outcome. Required reviewer: lead for schemas, migrations, authorization, signing or execution; another developer for all PRs.

## Dependencies
PF-001, PF-002, PF-003, PF-004, PF-005
Lead authorized continued implementation before teammate onboarding; developed on a stacked branch. Integration remains BLOCKED until reviewed dependency merges and lead review of the new session API contract.

## Paths Owned
- `services/api/app/core/auth.py`
- `apps/web/app/api/backend/[...path]/route.ts`
- `apps/web/app/login/`
Shared contracts, migrations and app/main.py are lead-owned. Request a separate contract-change PR for changes; regenerate OpenAPI + TypeScript and notify both consuming workstreams.

## API Contract
Preserve current domain routes and error envelope; add reviewed session routes, cookie/CSRF contract and explicit actor dependency

Canonical examples: `contracts/financial-state.example.json`, `contracts/action-request.example.json`, `contracts/requests.example.json`. These are shape fixtures, never evidence of live chain configuration or successful verification. Error envelope: `{"code":"NOT_IMPLEMENTED","message":"Feature awaiting implementation","reasons":[]}`. Amounts ending `_minor` are integer USD cents; token base units are decimal strings; probabilities are integer basis points.

## Test Commands
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest services/api/tests/test_pf_033.py -q` (create this issue's tests; command must collect tests and pass).
`npm run check` (backend tests + lint, contract generation, frontend lint/typecheck/build and real browser/API smoke).
For chain outcomes: attach a real Base Sepolia receipt + explorer link separately; mocked adapters are CI evidence only.

## Evidence / Notes
Status: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_CONTRACT_REVIEW; INTEGRATION_BLOCKED_ON_FOUNDATION. GitHub publication mapping is maintained in docs/ISSUE_BACKLOG.md.
Attach PR URL, commit SHA, exact commands/results and relevant screenshots/trace. Do not expose keys, RPC credentials, cookies or tokens.

## Definition of Done
Reviewed issue-linked PR merged with passing CI and integration evidence; dependent issue statuses updated. A code stub or fixture does not complete a feature.

## Out of scope
New scenarios, mainnet/real money, production custody, duplicate schemas, unrelated rewrites, or changes to approved architecture.
